subject: EdgeLayer customer demo opportunity at ScaleX Summit
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Lina Gomez <lina@averytech.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom@scalex.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: EdgeLayer customer demo opportunity at ScaleX Summit

Hi Lina —

Hope you’re doing well. I’m reaching out with a short invite: ScaleX Summit (Sept 14–15) has a 20-minute demo slot focused on live customer-led product showcases. The panel organizer (cc’d Tom) asked us to propose a customer who can do a short technical demo + 5–10 minutes of Q&A.

Avery Tech’s EdgeLayer integration is one of the clearest production stories we have — low-latency inference at scale and the observability improvements you shipped in Q1. Would Avery be open to doing a joint customer demo with Redwood? The ask is modest: Lina or an engineer on your end would do a 12–15 minute demo of the integration and we’ll join for the intro and a 5-minute wrap with highlights.

Logistics we can handle: we’ll ship a sanitized demo env, a short script, and handle AV. If you’re interested I can share a draft runbook and slide deck. There’s also an honorarium available for customer speakers.

No pressure — totally understand calendar realities. If yes, can you tell me: 1) who would present on your side, 2) any constraints (AV, internal approvals), and 3) if Sept 14 or 15 works better?

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jonas@redwood.com]
[Attachment: edgelayer_slide_deck.pdf (stub)]

From: Lina Gomez <lina@averytech.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom@scalex.com>
Date: 2026-06-02T09:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EdgeLayer customer demo opportunity at ScaleX Summit

Hi Jonas —

Thanks — this sounds interesting and I appreciate the heads-up. I spoke with our engineering lead (Marco) this morning and he’s willing to present. A few items to flag from our side:

- We’ll need a short security checklist before we allow a live deployment demo (pointer to SOC2 controls and a staging token).
- Speaker approvals go through our comms team (I’ll need to run the deck by them).
- Sept 15 is preferable for Marco.

If you can share the runbook and a 1-page speaker brief, I’ll start the internal approvals. Also, can Redwood provide a sanitized dataset and a read-only API key for the demo?

Happy to chat for 15 minutes this week if that’s easier.

Best,
Lina Gomez
Head of Product Partnerships | Avery Tech
[lina@averytech.com]

Can we: 1) put together a short runbook (steps + rollback) and a sanitized dataset by next Tue (6/9), 2) produce a 1-page speaker brief for approvals, and 3) check with events on honorarium logistics.

Thanks — all good updates. Quick checklist/status:

- Comms review: I’ll route the 1-pager to our external comms partner and get back by EOD Friday (6/6).
- Honorarium: Events confirmed there’s a $1,000 speaker stipend; I’ll forward the payment flow to finance.
- Staging key: Lauren confirmed a read-only staging key is possible; she’s sharing the account name and expiry window separately.
- Security checklist: Lauren has the standard SOC2 pointer + our demo sandbox checklist ready.

Jonas — once Lina confirms Marco’s speaker bio I’ll draft the co-branded slide template and a 2-slide outline for the demo. Lina / Marco — if you can send the short bio and any do-not-share items, we’ll keep the demo scrubbed.
